description:
Title: Building a House

You want to build a tree house.
First you collect your requirements, and send them to a tree house architect.
The architect sends you back a draft, which you refine multiple times with additional requirements.
You then create the list of needed materials from the plan.
These materials fall into several categories, you order them from several online stores.
While the order is processed, you send messages to several of your friends to build the house.
After the house is built, you send invitations for a tree house party to your friends.
In order to buy the snacks for the party, a list of people that attend the party is created.

                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/treehouse">

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Split_Refine" name="Additional requirements needed?" default="Flow_NoFurtherRefinement"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft" name="Receive revised draft from architect"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials from plan"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from online stores"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Split_Order" name="Order placed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RequestFriendsBuild" name="Send build request to friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_OrdersProcessed" name="Orders processed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrdersProcessed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_HouseBuilt" name="Receive house built notification"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Join_Order" name="Friends built house and orders processed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendInvitations" name="Send party invitations to friends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_TreeHouseWish" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" name="Yes" sourceRef="Split_Refine" targetRef="SendTask_SendAdditionalReq"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFurtherRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Split_Refine" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAdditionalReq" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft" targetRef="Merge_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="SendTask_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Split_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Split_Order" targetRef="SendTask_RequestFriendsBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Split_Order" targetRef="Catch_OrdersProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestFriendsBuild" targetRef="ReceiveTask_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_HouseBuilt" targetRef="Join_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Catch_OrdersProcessed" targetRef="Join_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Join_Order" targetRef="SendTask_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="End_PartyPrepared"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
